storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from damp; refrigerate or add a dried neem leaf or bay leaf in humid weather to deter weevils.
looksLike: Small, flat, chalk-white split lentils; black gram with the black skin removed.
howToPick: Chalk-white, even, clean splits with no black husk flecks, insects or webbing, and no musty smell. For dosa, ask for "dhuli" or "white split", not "chilka".
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months if kept dry (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Poha or cooked rice in the batter

usedIn.raw: 13 g per serving in the batter (about 1 tbsp, raw) plus 2 g in the tempering, 15 g in total
